caption_facebook:
December holidays in Nova Scotia: which days are paid?

Under the Labour Standards Code, Christmas Day (Friday, Dec 25) and New Year’s Day (Friday, Jan 1, 2027) are general paid holidays. Christmas Eve, Boxing Day and New Year’s Eve are not.

Who qualifies: an employee entitled to pay for at least 15 of the 30 calendar days before the holiday, who worked their last scheduled shift before it and their first scheduled shift after. Paid sick time, paid course time and vacation count.

Working Christmas Day? A qualifying employee gets a regular day’s pay, plus 1.5 times their regular rate for the hours they work.
Holiday on their day off? Give them another day off with pay: the next working day, during their vacation, or another date you agree on.

Retail: Boxing Day isn’t a general holiday under the Code, but it is a retail closing day. Most stores must close; some businesses are allowed to open.

Not legal advice. Sources: novascotia.ca, Holiday pay; novascotia.ca, Retail closing days and the right to refuse work.

Unpopular opinion: a seasonal hire deserves a real interview.

“It’s only till January” is how a five-minute chat replaces the interview. Then the person who can’t handle the Saturday rush is on the floor for the busiest six weeks of the year.

Same questions as any other hire, scored the same way. It takes the same time, and it’s the hire you’re most likely to want back next season.

Unpopular opinion: “we’re like a family” doesn’t belong in a job ad.

Families don’t have schedules, pay periods or probation. Jobs do.

Say what the job actually is: the shifts, the pay, who they report to, what a good first month looks like. That’s the warm part. It tells people you’ve thought about them before they’ve applied.

Who works the 24th, who gets the 26th, who’s off for New Year’s Day. Decide it early, write it down, and share it with everyone at once.

Rabi season: your pump runs every day now. Three checks.

1. Never let it run dry. If the water level drops below the pump, the motor runs without water and overheats. Switch off and check the level.
2. Use a proper starter. Low or uneven voltage is hard on a motor. A proper starter protects it. Never bypass it.
3. Watch the water. Less water than before, sand in the water or a new noise? Stop and get it checked before a small problem becomes a rewind.

Why does depth decide the pump?

It’s about what’s inside a V6 pump set: the motor at the bottom, then the strainer where water comes in, then the stages, then the discharge head where the pipe joins.

Each stage pushes the water up a little more. More stages, more height. That’s why a deep borewell needs a different pump set from a shallow one, and why we ask your water depth before we suggest a model.

Copper rotor motors drive every JJ pump set. Tell us your borewell size, water depth and field size on WhatsApp.
